x: Like many middle distance runners of the fifties, Pat attempted to mould himself on the lines of Emil Zatopek and he set himself some extremely vigorous training schedules and there is little doubt that on his day he was a man very much to be feared.
His time was under 2 minutes slower than an erstwhile world record set by none other than Emil Zatopek; and this in his first race over 10 miles!

The great Emil Zatopek who had in a small way contributed to my own downfall by running, in my humble opinion, far faster than was necessary in our heat, was matched against, among others, Gaston Reiff from Belgium.
